name: fbr-di
description: Local app for filing sales invoices to Pakistan's FBR Digital Invoicing system

scripts.test: bun test tests/ && bun run test:ui
scripts.build:win:icon: bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console --windows-icon=assets/icon.ico --windows-title="FBR Invoicing" --windows-description="Files sales invoices to FBR Digital Invoicing" --windows-publisher="FBR Digital Invoicing" --windows-version=0.1.0.0 src/server/index.ts --outfile dist/FBR-Invoicing.exe
